
netlab -- a break/fix lab for Linux networking, iptables and Kubernetes

  Almost every command needs root. Prefix with sudo.

LAB CONTROL
  netlab lab up                 Build the 3-namespace network topology
  netlab lab down               Remove it (host networking untouched)
  netlab lab rebuild            Tear down and rebuild from scratch
  netlab lab map                Print the topology diagram
  netlab status                 Health of the lab + cluster + active drill
  netlab doctor                 Check prerequisites on this machine

DRILLS  (break/fix exercises)
  netlab list [net|fw|k8s]      List drills and which you have passed
  netlab start <id>             Reset the lab, inject one fault, brief you
  netlab check [id]             Test whether you fixed it
  netlab hint [id]              A nudge that does not give the answer away
  netlab solution [id]          Full walkthrough with commands
  netlab reset [id]             Put the lab back to known-good
  netlab challenge <module>     Inject a RANDOM undisclosed fault
  netlab reveal                 Give up: name the fault you were given
  netlab progress               Scoreboard

WORKING INSIDE THE LAB
  netlab exec <ns> <cmd...>     Run one command in a namespace
                                  ns = client | router | server
  netlab sh <ns>                Interactive shell inside a namespace

KUBERNETES
  netlab k8s up                 Install k3s and seed the practice namespace
  netlab k8s status             Cluster / node / workload overview
  netlab k8s reset              Wipe and re-seed the 'netlab' namespace
  netlab k8s iptables           Show the rules kube-proxy wrote (great demo)
  netlab k8s down               Uninstall k3s

READING
  netlab guide                  List the guides shipped with this package
  netlab guide 04               Open guide 04 in a pager

SAFETY (for when you experiment on the REAL host firewall)
  netlab snapshot save [name]   Save host iptables + addresses + routes
  netlab snapshot restore <n>   Put the saved iptables ruleset back
  netlab snapshot list
  netlab deadman [minutes]      Auto-restore host iptables in N minutes
  netlab deadman-cancel         Disarm it once you are confident

SUGGESTED PATH
  1. netlab guide 00            Read the orientation guide
  2. sudo netlab lab up
  3. sudo netlab start net-01-link-down     ... work through the net-* drills
  4. ... then the fw-* drills
  5. sudo netlab k8s up         ... then the k8s-* drills
  6. sudo netlab challenge net  ... prove it stuck
